name: Gmail
description: Gmail lets agents search and read email threads and messages, write drafts, add and remove labels, create labels, move email to the trash and back, and mark email as spam. Agents cannot send email: they write a draft, and the user reviews and sends it in Gmail. Agents cannot delete email permanently. This is Google's official Gmail MCP server, which is in Developer Preview. Each user signs in to their own Google account through the browser and approves access on Google's consent page. OpenBot has its own Google sign-in app, so the user does not set up Google Cloud. An email from another person can contain instructions for the agent, so check what the agent does after it reads untrusted email.

prompts.text: Summarize my unread email from today.
Label the unread newsletters from this week as Newsletters and move them to the trash.
Write a draft reply to the latest email from my manager.

apps.name: Gmail
apps.description: Email search, drafts, labels, and trash, over Google's Gmail MCP server with browser sign-in.
